dialog.title: Invite
dialog.descriptionAdmin: The invited person creates an account themselves using the link. Registration without an invitation is not possible.
dialog.descriptionWorkspace: The invited person creates an account using the link and becomes a member of this workspace.
dialog.sent: Invitation sent to {email}. The link is valid for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} and can only be used once.
dialog.mailFailed: The invitation was created, but the email couldn’t be sent. Share the link below directly, or resend the invitation later.
dialog.linkOnce: This link will only be shown now. It isn’t stored anywhere, so copy it now if you need it.
dialog.languageHint: The email will arrive in this language, and eXocortex will address the person in it after signing in until they choose another one themselves.
dialog.noWorkspaceHint: Without a workspace, an account is created that can’t see anything yet. Memberships are always explicitly assigned here.
dialog.grantAdminHint: Can manage users, change settings, and see all workspaces.

table.emptyDescription: Anyone joining needs an invitation. Registration without one is disabled.
table.freshLinkHint: The previous link is no longer valid. Each resend creates a new one.
table.caption: Invitations
table.revokeDescription: The link sent to {email} will no longer work. If the person is to join after all, they will need a new invitation.
